name: app.gupsh.gupsh-mcp
description: Email marketing and analytics tooling for AI assistants via gupsh.
long_description: Provides MCP access to gupsh subscribers, broadcasts, automations, workflows and templates.

publishable_key.title: gupsh Publishable Key
publishable_key.description: Find this in gupsh backoffice → Settings → API keys.

secret_key.title: gupsh Secret Key
secret_key.description: Find this in gupsh backoffice → Settings → API keys.

site_uuid.title: gupsh Site UUID
site_uuid.description: Find this in gupsh backoffice → Settings → API keys.

api_base_url.title: API base URL
api_base_url.description: gupsh API origin and optional /api/v1 path.

tools.name: get_subscriber
tools.description: Look up a gupsh subscriber by email or UUID.

tools.name: batch_import_subscribers
tools.description: Import or update subscribers in bulk with custom fields and tags.

tools.name: list_tags
tools.description: List all tags in the gupsh site.

tools.name: create_tag
tools.description: Create a new tag.

tools.name: list_fields
tools.description: List all custom fields.

tools.name: create_field
tools.description: Create a custom field by key.

tools.name: track_event
tools.description: Track custom or purchase events for a subscriber.

tools.name: get_site_stats
tools.description: Retrieve aggregate stats for the gupsh site.

tools.name: get_ads_stats
tools.description: Get ads attribution stats by source, campaign, medium, content, or ad.

tools.name: list_broadcasts
tools.description: List email broadcasts/campaigns.

tools.name: create_broadcast
tools.description: Create a draft email broadcast.

tools.name: list_automations
tools.description: List sequences and/or workflows with optional pagination.

tools.name: list_workflows
tools.description: List workflows and their email templates.

tools.name: get_workflow
tools.description: Get a workflow's triggers, nodes, branches, and linked emails.

tools.name: get_workflow_stats
tools.description: Per-node entered, sent, opened, clicked, unsubscribe, and conversion stats for a workflow over a time window.

tools.name: list_sequences
tools.description: List email sequences and their templates.

tools.name: create_sequence_email
tools.description: Append an email template to a sequence by ID or name.

tools.name: get_email_template
tools.description: Fetch an email template by ID.

tools.name: update_email_template
tools.description: Update a template's subject or HTML content.

tools.name: update_sequence_email
tools.description: Update a sequence email template by template ID.
